output.final_answer: Claude Shannon was born on April 30, 1916, and passed away on February 24, 2001. His three key contributions to information theory include: 1) the development of a mathematical model for communication, 2) the establishment of the theoretical foundations for digital circuits, and 3) the authorship of the landmark paper 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication,' which created the framework for quantifying information transmission. Source: Britannica.
